answer: Every agent gets one vertex in a public trust graph, its influence the square of stake times months held. Newcomers prove themselves with a pulse, an hourly signed heartbeat from one registered device. A prism check splits that pulse into timing, device, history beams matching the vertex. Splitting $10,000 over 100 clones cuts influence a hundredfold, since squares punish division. Clones on one device emit identical pulses and collapse to one vertex. Matching one honest identity takes 100 clones and $1,000,000 locked 12 months. A sybil farm is one recording played through 100 speakers.
